CheckBoxPreference.app:title: Maximize Sensor Area
CheckBoxPreference.app:summary: Only show resolutions that use full sensor array area.

se.lth.math.videoimucapture.FloatSeekBar.app:title: Zoom ratio
se.lth.math.videoimucapture.FloatSeekBar.app:summary: Set to less than 1 to use wide lens.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Enable Distortion Correction
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Lets the phone un-warp frames before recording. Leave OFF for VIO and calibration: the recorded distortion parameters describe the raw lens, so corrected frames would be corrected twice. The mode that ran is recorded per frame.

ListPreference.app:title: Lenses in the session
ListPreference.app:summary: Extra camera streams besides the video. Metric pair: JPEG/RAW stills plus main and ultrawide streams for stereo. All rear lenses: also telephotos (if any). Video only: just the video stream, stills off; recommended for VIO, and needed for zoom-based lens switching. Applies when the camera reopens.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Focus at hyperfocal (manual focus only)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: With Auto Focus Mode = Manual, focus at this lens's hyperfocal distance: everything from about half that distance to infinity is sharp, and the lens never moves, so the focal length stays constant.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Raw pixels for the matcher
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Turns the phone's sharpening and noise reduction OFF, so feature detectors see real texture instead of sharpening halos. When off, the phone's defaults are left alone. The mode that ran is recorded per frame. Effect not yet measured.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Freeze exposure while recording
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Lock AE and AWB at the first frame so the clip has one radiometry. Off (with Continuous mode): auto exposure keeps running through the whole session and every frame records its own exposure and ISO.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Blur budget (experimental)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Cap exposure from the gyro so motion blur stays under the budget below, letting ISO rise instead. Needs Freeze exposure OFF. UNTESTED — verify on your device. Shows HOLD STILL when you are moving too fast for a sharp frame.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Blur budget (pixels)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Target maximum motion smear per frame, pixels. The AE cap aims at this.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Manual shutter for the budget (experimental)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Lets the blur budget switch to a manual shutter shorter than 1/30 s, raising ISO to match (the auto-exposure cap stops at 1/30 s). Hands exposure back when you slow down. More noise, less blur. Experimental.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Hold-still alarm (pixels)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Show HOLD STILL when the predicted motion smear exceeds this many pixels. The live SMEAR readout shows typical values for your motion.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Video bitrate
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Mbit/s. 0 = automatic (about 94 for the full sensor at 30 fps).

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Stereo pair every (seconds)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: While recording, keep a simultaneous main + ultrawide frame pair every N seconds (metric scale from the lens baseline). 0 = off. Runs the second sensor for the whole clip and may roughen the video cadence. Not available with Video only.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: IMU batching
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Lets the IMU buffer samples in hardware for up to this many ms before delivering them (saves power). Timestamps are unaffected. 0 = off, recommended; keep 0 for stills runs, whose triggers read the IMU live.

SeekBarPreference.app:title: Camera sleep after
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Seconds idle before the preview stops and the sensor goes quiet. 0 = never. Tap to wake.
